correctness.rationale: Verified factorization p1=s1(s1+s2), semicircular laws of factors (var 1 and var 2), bounded-density log-integrability, exact integral I(1)=-1/2 via t=2sin(theta) and digamma values (recomputed: J=-pi/2 correct), scaling I(sigma)=log sigma+I(1), FK multiplicativity with no freeness needed, Delta(p1)=sqrt(2)/e>0, and Brown log-identity contrapositive with ||p1||<=8 compact support. The draft's inequality omits the bounded positive part (log M) but the corrected bound -n*m+log M still gives -infinity, so conclusion stands. Quadrature reproduced I1=-0.499996, I2=-0.153423 to <1e-3.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified: same admitted object p1=s1^2+s1s2, proves first of two target components via target work, gap half honestly left open. Fused 20-result search over literal, factored/FK-determinant, and general atom-classification forms found no same-object or same-parameter source. Nearest leads (Ho x0+elliptic family; Anderson anticommutator; Mingo-Speicher survey) have disjoint theorem scope. Full-text inspection of Ho confirms non-coverage. No broader census, table, or database covers the exact determinant/atom value.

value.rationale: Exact invariant mu1({0})=0 plus sharp determinants Delta(s1)=e^{-1/2}, Delta(s1+s2)=sqrt(2)e^{-1/2}, Delta(p1)=sqrt(2)/e for the pre-motivated admitted polynomial, resolving half the high-risk target exactly. Value was motivated before computation, is not known or mechanically implied, fixes prerequisite Delta(p1)>0 for future gap analysis, and is a self-contained Brown-measure atom theorem. Per STANDARD, a narrow exact invariant of a natural object needs no new general theorem; incomplete r1 survey does not erase the headline.
